# Benchmark font

`JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf` is an unmodified JetBrains Mono 2.304 font,
copied from the Kelivo source snapshot in `UPSTREAM.md`.

SHA-256: `a0bf60ef0f83c5ed4d7a75d45838548b1f6873372dfac88f71804491898d138f`.

The font retains the SIL Open Font License 1.1, included in
`JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt`. It is test data, not an application asset.
